text.content:
Latin name: Via Regalis

Virtues: Conviction, Self-Control

God ordained that Man would have dominion over the beasts of the earth; followers of the Via Regalis (Scions) believe that as Man is above animals, Cainites are above humanity, with dominion over the herds of mortals. As God ordains the just rule of kings over subjects, certain Cainites are predestined to rule over their kind — but to rule others, one must first rule oneself through inner discipline and self-mastery, including mastery of the Beast. Via Regalis draws many High Clans, especially the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra}, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce}, and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.OpCOs3PLjmtl0QVu]{Ventrue}, and many princes follow this road, embracing chivalry and feudal fealty as expressions of their code.

The Ethics:

  • There are only two roles in this world: that of master and that of servant.
  • You are superior to mortals, made to rule.
  • To master others, you must first master yourself and the Beast within.
  • Only those who seize power gain it; only those who use power keep it.
  • Your word is your bond. Without it, you are nothing.

Aura of Conviction (Command): Command. Followers of Via Regalis demand respect, and their commands are followed without question; their aura modifier becomes active during challenges to command or lead others.

Hierarchy of Sins (most to least severe):

  1. Neglecting your duty; treating a peer with disrespect.
  2. Treating an inferior as an equal; breaking your word to a peer.
  3. Behaving shamefully before your peers; showing weakness in front of inferiors.
  4. Failing to answer a challenge to your honor; treating a superior with disrespect.
  5. Breaking your word to your superiors; breaking a sworn oath.

vtmlarp.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages Vampire, revised as The Long Night)
